title: Parent category cannot be bound to a product
precondition: Vendor creating a new product in the Vendor Portal
steps: In the category selector, select Tier 1 'Electronics' or Tier 2 'Computers'
expected: Form validation blocks the save and asks for a Tier-3 leaf category

title: Product saves under a Tier-3 leaf category
precondition: Vendor creating a new product in the Vendor Portal
expected: Product is created and bound to 'Laptops'

title: Generator creates one variant per size and colour combination
precondition: Product creation form open for 'Cotton T-Shirt'
steps: Add attribute Size (S, M, L) and Color (Red, Blue)
expected: 3 x 2 = 6 unique variant rows with auto-generated SKUs

title: Overridden variant price persists
expected: Size L variants show 899, all others 799

title: 51st product is blocked by the Quota Gate
precondition: Vendor on Starter Plan (max 50 products) with 50 published
steps: Attempt to publish a 51st product in the vendor portal
expected: Upload is blocked by the Quota Gate

title: Stock toggle updates the public badge
steps: In the inventory table, toggle the product from 'In Stock' to 'Out of Stock'
expected: The public catalog shows the 'Out of Stock' badge immediately

title: Category request is recorded
precondition: Vendor cannot find a specialised category
steps: Click 'Request New Category' in the vendor form
Enter Proposed Name 'Terracotta Pots', Parent 'Home & Garden'
expected: A row is written to category_requests

title: Approved category appears and vendor is notified
expected: Leaf node is inserted into the taxonomy tree and the vendor receives a push notification

title: Create a product end to end inside the catalog module
precondition: Approved vendor on Starter Plan with free quota
steps: Create a product under leaf category 'Laptops'
Generate variants and override one price
expected: Product is published with its variants and prices, counts against the quota, and shows 'Out of Stock'
